RCP Singh meets Nitish Kumar, sparking speculation of return to JD(U)

Former Union Minister RCP Singh met with Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar, leading to speculation about his potential return to the Janata Dal (United) party. The meeting was described as a brief courtesy call. This development has fueled discussions about a possible political realignment in Bihar.
